title: Inverted chord: root identification works
purpose: confirms the chord-state machinery works for inversions (root is not the bass note). The "until the root releases" behavior depends on correctly identifying the root.
expected_prose:
- t=0 to t=1000: state=chord, identity=(C, major), confidence=declared. Even though the bass note is E (this is C major first inversion), the root is C.
- t=1000 to t=2000: bass E released. Remaining: [67, 72] (G+C). Root (C, MIDI 72) still held → state=chord, identity=(C, major), confidence=implied.
- t=2000+: state=nothing.
trailing_notes: This test depends on `chord-resolver.js` correctly identifying the root for inversions. See OQ5 in the design doc.
